item.title: Version 1.2
item.description:
What's new in Voilà 1.2

  • New look: a warm apricot and lavender palette, soft warm backgrounds instead of gray, and a new app icon.
  • Focus mode: starting a task collapses Voilà to the compact pill; pausing it brings the full panel back.
  • Redesigned compact pill: a large live timer, a breathing focus dot and a progress line along the bottom edge. It keeps the panel's width and adapts when the panel is narrow.
  • Pausing a task now clears the focus card instead of leaving a "Paused" card behind.

Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple: open the DMG and drag Voilà to Applications. Requires macOS 26 or later (Apple Silicon or Intel).
